# How many employees does Wellinks have?

Wellinks, Inc. has approximately102 total employees worldwide as ofJune 2026, according to Revelio Labs workforce intelligence data.Wellinks’s total headcount has declined42.5% from 177 employees in 2023 to 102 in 2026.

Data source: Revelio Labs•Coverage: Global workforce, 2023–2026•Published August 2026

## Is Wellinks hiring right now?

Yes, Wellinks isactively hiring. Wellinks had5 active job postings in 2026, a 200.0% increase from 2025— [see job openings & hiring trends](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/wellinks/employees#postings).

## About Wellinks’s Workforce

Wellinks, Inc. is a Healthcare and Wellness Services company that employs **102** people worldwide as of June 2026. It is the 8th-largest by headcount among its [peers](https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/wellinks/employees#similar-companies). Founded in 2014, the company is headquartered in New Haven, Connecticut.

Wellinks's workforce has declined **42.5%** from 2023 to 2026, down **14.7%** year over year in 2026. It fell to a low of **102** in 2026 Q2 before recovering. Its workforce is concentrated most in North America ( **82.5%**), followed by Northern Europe ( **14.9%**) and Pacific Islands ( **2.6%**).

Wellinks's functional groups are Finance and Operations ( **59.9%**), Engineering ( **26.9%**), and Sales and Marketing ( **13.2%**), with Finance and Operations growing fastest (up **5.4%**). The average salary is **$120,032,** ranging from a median of **$112,000** in North America to **$86,000** in Northern Europe, down **8.3%** year over year in 2026.

Wellinks's active job postings rose **200.0%** in 2026 to **5**, with new postings per month cooling from **6** in 2023 to **1** in 2026. Overall employee sentiment is negative but improving.
